title: Chris's reaction to anomalous metal, and only two others seen before

tellings.quote: He told me there were only he'd only ever seen two other reactions.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has many encounters with strange craft, tells of a piece of unusual metal tested in Zanesville, Ohio. He says a man named Timothy Taylor, who examined it, told him the metal reacted in a way he had only ever seen two other times, which would suggest the material is not ordinary.
